dict.string: Adds new themes to Dopamine, alongside the stock ones. Pick one in Dopamine → Settings → Theme.

Trollamine, Cobalt, Aurora, Sunset, Midnight, Sakura, Golden Hour, Phantom.
Close Dopamine from the app switcher and reopen it after installing or flipping the switch.
Add your own: put a .plist (same keys as Dopamine's Themes.plist) and a background image in /var/jb/Library/DopaThemes.
DopaThemes 1.0 from Cobalt.
